title: Your startup’s next teammate might be an AI agent: Gusto, Insight Partners, and Leland explain what that changes at TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
summary: AI agents are beginning to take on engineering, customer support, research, and operational work that would previously have been assigned to early team members. That’s the conversation Josh Reeves, Michelle Johnson, and John Koelliker will take on at Disrupt.
